subject: Onboarding: PO issuance audit, spend cap request & line-item mapping

Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO number and spend cap question

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. We're moving Redwood through our vendor onboarding and procurement checklist. Two quick asks as we prepare the initial PO: 1) can you confirm the billing code(s) Redwood will accept so we can map line items correctly in our ERP, and 2) we'd like to issue an initial PO with a spend cap of $75,000 for Q3 while the footprint stabilizes. If possible, can you provide the completed vendor onboarding form and Redwood's preferred PO template?

We'll need the PO to reference a single master billing line plus optional sub-line items for seats/consumption buckets. If another format is required, please flag it and we'll try to accommodate.

Appreciate it — Leah

Leah O'Connor
Vendor Ops Lead, Acme Logistics
leah.oconnor@acme-logistics.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO number and spend cap question

Leah —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attached is our standard onboarding form (filled) and our PO template (Excel) — the PO template includes the master billing code and recommended sub-line item breakdown for consumption and committed seats. High level answers below:

- Preferred billing code: RED-INF-BILLING-01 (use this as the primary cost center).
- Sub-lines: "Inference Consumption (tokens)" and "Dedicated Seat/Reserved Capacity". We recommend including both so usage can be tracked independently.
- Initial spend cap: Redwood is fine with an initial $75,000 cap for Q3 but we do need a short escalation path if usage exceeds forecast (we can auto-notify and request temporary burst allowance).

I've looped in Marissa from Finance for PO issuance and assignment of the master PO number. Marissa — can you confirm the PO number format (internal prefix) and whether Acme's ERP requires any additional fields on the invoice?

Thanks,
Mina

Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Hi Leah / Mina —

Thanks for the details. Finance can issue the master PO once Acme returns a signed copy of the onboarding form and confirms bill-to contact. A couple of operational notes:

- PO number format: RW-2026-ACME-XXXXX (we'll assign RW-2026-ACME-10432 for your initial PO once we have the signed form).
- Spend cap handling: we can record the $75,000 as a capped commitment in our billing system; any overages will require an approved exception. For operational continuity, we can provision a temporary burst window (up to 10%) if notified 24 hours in advance.
- Line-item mapping: our template includes SKU codes for "inference_tokens" and "dedicated_capacity_hour". If your ERP needs different fields, send an example mapping and Karthik can help translate.

Leah, please return the signed onboarding form to finance@redwood.ai and include the Acme ERP export sample if possible.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick note on mapping and a small line-item correction we spotted in the submitted onboarding form: the CSV from Acme maps consumption to "compute_token_count" but our export/sku expects "inference_tokens". I've attached a one-page mapping guide and a corrected sample PO line table to make translation painless.

Also: for invoicing cadence, Redwood prefers consolidated monthly invoices (single invoice referencing the PO), but we can do per-billing-event if Acme needs it for internal reconciliation.

Action items:
- Marissa: please generate PO RW-2026-ACME-10432 when you confirm the billing contact.
- Leah: confirm whether Acme wants monthly consolidated invoices OR per-event invoices.
- Mina: I'll follow up after PO issuance to ensure line-items are aligned with consumption telemetry.

Thanks,
Karthik

Leah / team —

Confirming Finance has issued PO RW-2026-ACME-10432 (attached stub of issued PO). The $75,000 spend cap for Q3 has been recorded in our billing system. Two operational items:

1) Exception for burst: We approved a one-time temporary exception to allow a 15% burst (up from the standard 10%) for the first seven days after go-live to account for higher-than-expected pilot traffic. This exception is logged under deal DL-7832-A and will require sign-off if further increases are requested.

2) Line-item correction: updated SKU names to match Acme export mapping (see attached corrected line table). Please ensure any invoices reference RW-2026-ACME-10432 in the invoice header.

Leah — can you confirm receipt and whether Acme will accept consolidated monthly invoices? Once confirmed, we'll share the formal invoice schedule and enable billing alerts to the procurement mailbox.

Best,
Marissa
